unlisted_practices: Invest in foundational digital infrastructure, including mobile connectivity and reliable power for health facilities, before deploying digital health and AI.
Scale the electronic immunization registry nationally and integrate it with existing health information systems to create an interoperable data ecosystem.
Build targeted capacity among health workers to translate AI knowledge into practice, particularly in midwifery and public health.
Deliver community-centered risk communication in Somali and tailored to local contexts alongside digital tools to counter misinformation and build vaccine confidence.
Donors should protect and expand funding for routine immunization, cold-chain, and front-line health workers as the foundation for digitalization.
Adopt a phased, equity-driven strategy for digitalization and AI adoption.
Extend AI-enabled outbreak prediction models to measles and other vaccine-preventable diseases to enable proactive response.

screen.reason: Commentary/letter arguing for the strategic investment and deployment of digitalization and AI (e.g., predictive modeling) in Somalia's healthcare system.
